content.short: Discover Swop, a highly optimized DeFi Dapps protocol focusing on decentralized exchanges to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Swop is an Automated Market Maker (AMM) on the Waves blockchain offering low-cost token swaps and liquidity pools. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Swop redefines how users interact with decentralized exchanges. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Ethereum to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Swop stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
content.meta: Swop is redefining decentralized exchanges on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Swop directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
